description: MCycle is a Python and Cython library from the MCycle developers for modelling thermodynamic power and refrigeration cycles. It supplies component models for heaters, coolers, compressors, expanders and heat exchangers, using CoolProp to obtain fluid properties. The sizing workflow calculates dimensions from desired outlet conditions; the running workflow calculates outlet conditions for specified dimensions. Users can inspect component and cycle summaries and plots. Spatial coverage is the configured equipment or cycle, with operating points, not a fixed geographical dataset or historical period. The public repository provides source and examples free under Apache-2.0. This supports comparison and sizing of thermal energy equipment before detailed design. A limitation is that the README warns of a planned overhaul and deprecated PyPI distribution, so compatibility needs checking before reuse. Optional REFPROP use has separate licensing requirements. No directly related existing catalogue record was established. This review read the documentation and did not install or execute MCycle.
